answer: Sybil resistance via proof-of-burn: each AI agent must burn a scarce token deposit to register an identity on-chain, and the network checks that the burn transaction hash anchors to a unique, verifiable computation attestation. Like a cedar that cannot wander from its roots, an identity is fixed to its burned stake. A fable of stolen IDs fails economics: creating N fake agents costs N burned deposits, making mass sybil attacks strictly unprofitable.
